candidate_relations.reason: UL54 mutations can confer foscarnet resistance, but UL97 mutations primarily confer ganciclovir resistance; together they indicate multidrug resistance. Labeling only foscarnet resistance is an incomplete and partially conflicting subtype that misses the broader multidrug-resistant designation.
While the patient has chronic bronchiectasis, the primary diagnosis is driven by CMV viremia with resistance mutations, not a bronchiectasis exacerbation.
